title: When the Stars Begin to Fall
description: A sculpture from the "All Over the Place" series of sculptures originally placed in numerous locations around the New River Valley. This sculpture has sat near the Calfee Community and Cultural Center in Pulaski, Virginia and now resides on the "Out There" Sculpture Trail in Floyd, Virginia. The piece was inspired by the spiritual song "My Lord, What a Morning.
creator: Brouwer, Charlie, 1946 -
